answer: Random beacon spot-checks plus heartbeats stop fake identities. Each epoch the beacon issues a challenge each must answer, plus a heartbeat of work. A miss suspends it, a second burns 30% of its 50 POA bond. Audits sample 30%: each plume of work must be its own, and a raven echoing another heartbeat is flagged. Forging 1,000 identities locks 50,000 POA and needs 1,000 streams. An honest agent pays one bond; its jade-clear record earns full value.
